basis: Offline replay of current service; returned rows counted, empty reads count one. Excludes metadata requests and provider implementation overhead.

idleMonth.basis: One empty queue query per scheduled pass plus one hourly empty cleanup query; no retries or real traffic included.

noReplyComparisonLimitation: Status polls no longer dispatch the next request after a timeout; recovery may add up to five minutes. The 130-second traces therefore have different terminal/queued states.
